notes: Backends: cpu = math_resp.c over math_dist.c prefix states (single-threaded: two binary searches and exact 256-bit arithmetic per theta), cuda = one work item per theta (device runs only), numpy = one float64 pass over the rows per theta, duckdb = SUM over a cross join (DuckDB's own threads).
Construction (histogram, prefix state) is paid once; each later theta costs O(log breakpoints) with no scan of the rows. A single theta is cheaper as one direct pass (the one-shot records).
